name: Visual director CLI
purpose: Engine routing and Blender plates: drafts per-scene engine decisions from storyboard.json, checks visual-plan.json, plate scripts and plate renders, renders plates under the host lock with stamped fingerprints, and installs the pinned Blender.
capabilities: render <slug> [--plate] [--format] [--preview] [--force] [--dry-run] (run by studio.py build, stage plates)

compatibility.notes: Pure Python plus Blender and FFmpeg for rendering; plan and check run anywhere.

licensing.notes: Internal workspace component; no third-party code copied.

security.notes: Network only for install-blender (download.blender.org, pinned hash). Writes projects/<slug>/visual-plan.json, blender/, src/plates/ and renders/plates/.

approval_evidence: tests/test-visual-director.py; end-to-end plate render and HyperFrames composite on the Windows host 2026-11-24.
